block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Canonical attributes, vitals, scaling curves & tactical math model.
what_it_enables: Tri-Vital Resource Model (HP: Health, MP: Magic, TP: Tactical Points)
TP-to-Grid Movement Economy & Overworld-to-Battle advantage translation
Hex-Attribute System (ATK, DEF, MATK, MDEF, AGI, LUK) with lore names
Deterministic damage calculation and bounded continuum clamping
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in math evaluations (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Vitals and attributes strictly non-negative integers [0, MAX_VAL]
TP movement step cost strictly >= 1.0 (no zero-cost traversal)

HP.description: Biological and planar life force. Reaching 0 results in incapacitation or defeat.
HP.base_scaling: Base Vitals Curve from Class Tier
HP.combat_role: Primary survival pool for physical and magical damage absorption.

MP.description: Metaphysical mana pool powering incantations, barrier domes, and spirit summons.
MP.base_scaling: Scaled by MATK and Class Growth
MP.combat_role: Resource currency for Mage spells, Priest wards, and relic resonant invocations.

TP.description: Tactical mobility currency spent to move on the grid and execute overworld actions.
TP.base_scaling: Base 100 TP pool, restored turn-by-turn based on AGI and stance
TP.combat_role: Governs grid movement, tandem martial arts (Duo-Loca), and overworld ambush advantages.

ATK.description: Kinetic striking power and physical weapon lethality.

DEF.description: Physical resilience against blades, bludgeons, and kinetic impacts.
DEF.scales_with: Armor, Shield of Lux, Warding Stance (+25% mitigation)

MATK.description: Metaphysical potency governing spells, catalysts, and healing arts.

MDEF.description: Resistance against arcane corruption, planar decay, and elemental blasts.
MDEF.combat_formula: Magic Mitigation = MDF / 2, status ailment resistance
MDEF.scales_with: Talismans, Robes, Priest classes, Lux Barrio (+25%)

AGI.description: Speed, turn order initiative, physical evasion, and action velocity.
AGI.combat_formula: Initiative Score = AGI + rand(1, 10); Evasion Rate % = AGI / 4
AGI.scales_with: Light Armor, Rogue classes, Light Steps state

LUK.description: Cosmic serendipity, critical strike probability, and rare item discovery.
LUK.combat_formula: Critical Strike Chance % = LUK / 5; Drop Bonus % = LUK / 10
LUK.scales_with: Relic resonance balance, Accessories, Observer Bearer
